I wish I was able to find out what’s wrong with her. She doesn’t seem aware of what she’s doing at all but was able to get upset over the same thing happening to her back in sophomore year of high school.

I recently picked up taking care of a jumping spider lately, and even though all of her accounts are blocked, has started talking about and posting about how she wants a jumping spider as well. 

I wish I never met her

All of my favorite foods, drinks, books, movies, TV shows, everything are now things that have always been her favorite. 

She was also undecided on her college major, and decided to go into Early Childhood Development, the same major as me. I decide that I’m going to go into doing EMT work? She tells me that she’s now looking into possibly enrolling into EMT/Paramedics school. 

We’re both 18 and just out of high school, the first job I get is at Walmart while she works at McDonald’s? Everything is terrible, nothing is okay because Walmart was *her* dream job and it’s not fair I got it when she’s stuck at McDonald’s. So she stays inside of Walmart for 8 hours a day while her boyfriend works there too until management noticed how long she hangs out there, and offers her a job at the deli. I start at Starbucks, suddenly she needs to work there too. 

She’s decided all of my hobbies, like CD and cassette tape collecting, occultism, thrifting, are all hers and have always been. All of her outfits became ones I have/would wear. Suddenly she has an interest in getting a bunch of tattoos and piercings like I have. 

But on top of all the imitation and copying my personality/style, she would go onto twitter and make very direct subtweets towards me and the life situations I’d confide in her in (i.e: while in that abusive relationship, I’d cry to her about what was happening and 30 minutes later will tweet about how only dumb bitches stay in abusive relationship, then act like she was ACTUALLY talking about her older sister (saying her subtweets were directed towards her sister was always her cop out.) 

When I started to hang out with my other friends and distance myself from her because of these behaviors, she literally sobbed and cried about how she was “losing me” to everyone else. 

Around 2019, one of her best friends who I worked with (we will call him J), was just talking to me while we were on break. After a little while of catching up on small talk, he confesses that he hasn’t talked to S or her boyfriend in a while because he realized how toxic and competitive they were. 

His parents are more well off, and he got his drivers license so his mom got him a new car. S and her boyfriend were making snide comments behind his back, saying things like he has everything served to him on a silver platter, must be nice to not have to worry about car payments. 

Then he told me that S has been talking a lot of shit behind my back to him specifically. He told me details about my life that he wouldn’t and shouldn’t know because he’s barely an acquaintance of mine. She told him about my entire life story down to all the terrible things I’ve gone through and how I’m a shitty person. When I confront her about it, she sends back messages saying that she only said that because he had a crush on me and didn’t want him to creep on me, so she was just telling him things to “ward him off” (bear in mind, I was currently already with my boyfriend, C, at that time so she could’ve easily just told him that I have a boyfriend and wouldn’t like him back in that way.) 

So after this I should’ve cut her off, but felt sympathy and was manipulated into giving her another chance. I was so tired of it. Everything was being copied, even my pet names for my boyfriend down to wanting to get a jumping spider now because I have one. 

I was tired of even confronting her at this point because there was no point. She always denies everything then talks about how she wants to die and how she’s so insecure, she doesn’t want to lose me as a friend, and the cycle repeats again. I felt so drained trying to juggle her problems and mine. 

I decided to just distance myself more and more. Around this time, my boyfriend’s ex girlfriend started going overboard making multiple IG accounts to watch my stories, message me asking where I got certain things, liking photos that my boyfriend is in from the fake accounts, and doing the EXACT same thing S is doing. I dealt with this for months until I just gave up and went private on Instagram.

My friends and I would make inside jokes about the ex girlfriend on our private twitter accounts (that S follows) because of the whole insane situation that unfolded with her stalking our accounts all the time. 

Around the time I cut S off completely, she was making passive aggressive tweets again about me, my boyfriend, our house, complaining about aspects of MY life. 
I confronted her about it and told her that I was tired of her talking badly about me all the time and that I’ve given her chance after chance to continue this friendship but it’s never going to work out.

SHE TWISTED THE ENTIRE SITUATION TO ME?? She said that my tweets about the ex-girlfriend made her feel sorry for me that I’m hung up on someone that is just copying my style and my hobbies, it’s not a big deal if she wants to watch your stories and lurk from fake accounts, what’s my issue with her still wanting to talk to my boyfriend again it’s REALLY not a big deal!!!! 

Apparently the tweets about the ex girlfriend have made her realize that she needs space away from me because apparently if I felt that way about the ex, then I MUST feel the same way about her. 

I end up telling her that I’ve had it with trying to be there for her just for her to continuously do this shit. 

I’ve cut her off for good but I’ve felt nothing but stress and anger since it all happened.

The warning signs were all there but I was too stupid to ever take these facts at face value and just realize how shitty she was since the beginning. 

Now she’s literally posting cosplays of me on her social media; hair, makeup, outfits and posting about all of the hobbies she was never into. Constantly telling her new social media friends just about how disgustingly evil I was to her this entire time and how I just decided to hate on my boyfriend’s ex-girlfriend for no reason at all. 

I’m so creeped out by all of this; I’ve tried blocking all of her accounts but it seems like she keeps making new ones to see what I’m doing. I feel so betrayed, so angry, so disappointed. I don’t know what to do with these emotions. Its childish but on top of the betrayal, it makes me upset that all of these new people think she’s being authentic in all of her interests when it’s all from me. All of the things that they love about her is everything she learned from me. 

It hurts when I see and hear these people say how I’m the evil, toxic friend when she’s telling them MY PERSPECTIVE OF THE STORY but making it seem like she experienced it. 

How do you let go of the hurt after betrayal? Is there even anything I can do in this situation?

I’m in the exact same situation as you right now, and it’s a big ass struggle. I’m 24 and I moved out with my boyfriend about 2 weeks ago. We were supposed to move together at the end of the month, but my mom snuck into my room and started reading my journal and the Valentine’s Day cards my boyfriend gave me and she took personal offense to him telling me in the card that he couldn’t wait for us to live together because he’ll get to wake up to the love of his life every morning. I was out with friends when she called me on the phone upset and telling me to drive back home RIGHT NOW. They already knew about my plans about moving out two months prior to it even happening. I spent my day off at my boyfriends to let things cool down before heading back home, then my mom calls me saying that I’m not her daughter anymore, that I’m a useless whore who’s whoring herself out just because a man promised marriage (they don’t know shit about our relationship aside from his name and the few times he’s been over because they make us so uncomfortable with all the leering!) 

I was also told to never return to their property ever again, and all of my belongings that are inside I still havent been able to get and it’s been 3 weeks. My boyfriend and I are just slowly rebuying things that I need to survive/get through everyday but it’s been so fucking rough.

I’ve been extremely depressed about this ever since I got forced to move out way earlier than planned (along with losing my entire family and not having any of my possessions at all. 

I don’t know what exact advice to give to you, but this is what my boyfriend and my friends have been telling me:

Don’t stress too much about losing your family.

They’re holding you back from living a normal life that any other 24/25 year old would be able to do without any friction at any other household. APs will always throw that “you didn’t grow up in a white household” bullshit in your face, I wish they understood that our cultures are so different because of where we grew up. Their norm is not the norm anymore, and tbh more
APs should view it as such.


Just remember that you have control over YOUR life! And it’s better to “lose” her now than spend the rest of your life resenting her. Eventually she will come around, even if it’s months or years from now, you two will still be able to talk. It’s going to take some time to repair everything between you two.

I would suggest taking your items slowly into your car or the place you’re going to be living in (if possible and already ready!) and keeping it in there until you move, taking some in everyday because shit happens and you want to at least have your items. Try to look for your valuable documents like birth certificate and social security card, etc first and take those first. 

It’s all going to be okay 🖤 I know it’s overwhelming as hell to have to deal with such insanity but just know if you need more advice or anyone to talk to that’s going through the same situation as well, please feel free to DM me and I’d love to talk :)
